findings.title: Spec text left stale after the F6(e) founder decision
findings.detail: The draft still says at E008.yaml:482-483 (2D_Case_6 spot_note) that the runner 'runs no spot check of its type then (see founder_decisions_before_registration)'. That item has been removed from founder_decisions_before_registration and moved to founder_decisions_settled. The description of the declared sanity check F6e_stack_type_spot_check (lines 1424-1439) also covers only the 'no admissible reference' case and never mentions the new report-only status 'only reference excluded: <reason>'. The code and founder_decisions_settled agree with each other. The registered contract text (the declared check description) is incomplete for the case D0019's set is expected to hit (2D_Case_6).
findings.evidence: grep 'see founder_decisions_before_registration' -> experiments/drafts/E008.yaml:483; F6e_stack_type_spot_check description at lines 1424-1439 has no 'only reference excluded'
findings.suggested_check: Before registration, add the excluded-only-reference reading to the F6e_stack_type_spot_check description and fix the spot_note pointer.

findings.title: Mixed-type edge case is reported as 'no admissible reference'
findings.detail: Suppose a non-default stack type has one admissible reference that is excluded (TwinError, DegradeError or a D-definition miss) and another reference that is inadmissible and not excluded. Run.drive (lines 1548-1563) then puts the type in spot_none, and evaluate reports it as 'no admissible reference of this stack type'. That is wrong, because an admissible reference of the type existed but was excluded. The spot_excluded branch handles only types with every reference excluded. D0019's set (2R and Case 6, each on its own type) cannot reach this case, so the stated scope is not affected.
findings.evidence: experiments/runners/e008_run.py:1548-1563: the spot_excluded loop iterates only over types absent from the non-excluded refs
findings.suggested_check: Add an exclusion selftest case with two references of one type (one admissible and excluded, one inadmissible and kept), or note the reading in the spec.

findings.title: burst_full.sh: 'rerun' cannot recover if the exit-code read fails and the VM later stops
findings.detail: After wait_phase, the script saves STEP_phaseA (or phaseB) and then reads the runner's exit code over ssh. If that one read fails, the script exits 7 and the documented remedy is 'Rerun'. On a rerun, step_done phaseA is true, so ensure_running is skipped and runner_exit goes straight to ssh. Phase A's backstop `shutdown -h +1800` is still pending after the job ends, so if the founder reruns after the VM has stopped (backstop or host event), every rerun exits 7 again. Recovery then needs a manual `gcloud compute instances start`.
findings.evidence: burst_full.sh lines 212-220 (mark phaseA before runner_exit; no ensure_running on the resume path) and 255-260 (same for phase B); line 175 schedules a shutdown that is never cancelled
findings.suggested_check: Call ensure_running before runner_exit when RC_A or RC_B is empty, or cancel the backstop (shutdown -c) once the rc file exists.

findings.title: The deviation statement is accurate but not exhaustive
findings.detail: The new statement correctly drops the earlier overstatement ('no power-copper rule changed') and names D0018 decision 1 (the 1.5 mm power-width floor for D) and the T0317 removal of the gate/Kelvin wire-length bound. These match D0018 decision 1 and D0019 Context and item 2. It does not list D0018 decision 2 (a D that misses F1(b) is excluded rather than failed), nor T0317's rule that D band-solver failures make the run INVALID. D0019 counts both as part of 'exactly the T0316 and T0317 changes'. The statement covers them only generically ('E008's runner and spec changed afterwards (T0316, T0317)'). Nothing in it is false.
findings.evidence: project/decisions/D0019 lines 14-17 and 39-44; D0018 decisions 1-2; E008.yaml f3_declared_deviation.statement
findings.suggested_check: Optionally name D0018 decision 2 and the T0318 INVALID rule in rules_changed.
